title: Cleaning Dates and Time

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study cleaning dates and time in the context of data cleaning and preprocessing. You will connect the PDF subtopics to a small example and practice describing what the evidence does—and does not—support.
content.why_it_matters: Cleaning Dates and Time matters because it affects how data is collected, represented, analyzed, interpreted, or used in a decision. Check the task and assumptions before choosing a method.

content_blocks.title: The central idea
content_blocks.text: Cleaning means making explicit, documented decisions about quality problems while preserving provenance and avoiding transformations that leak future information.

items.title: Date parsing
items.text: Define date parsing in relation to cleaning dates and time; identify the input, output, assumptions, and who uses the result.

items.title: Time zones
items.text: Work through time zones using a small, synthetic example before scaling up. State what the calculation or method returns and why that result is useful.

items.title: Daylight-saving transitions
items.text: Check the edge cases for daylight-saving transitions: missing values, unusual ranges, different groups, time boundaries, or a changed input can affect the conclusion.

items.title: Date ranges and invalid dates
items.text: Document the rule or choice for date ranges and invalid dates so another learner can reproduce the analysis and understand its limitations.

items.title: Date components and durations
items.text: Define date components and durations in relation to cleaning dates and time; identify the input, output, assumptions, and who uses the result.

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes
content_blocks.text: Keep the question, data grain, units, and assumptions explicit. If a result differs, inspect the input and steps in order. Avoid turning an observed association into a causal claim, treating a sample as the population, or assuming a small demonstration guarantees production behavior. Make normalization rules explicit, then verify that the merge of categories is appropriate.
